_comment: Registry of persistent explorable maps. kind 'village' = a settlement map driven by data/village/village_layouts.json; kind 'poi' = a hand-authored point of interest. status 'reserved' = the identifier is fixed but the location is not built yet (MapTravelService refuses to enter it). Generated expedition areas are not listed: their map id is 'wilderness:<landmark_id>' and they open the 'exploration' scene. `scene` is a Router scene key. Persistent per-map state is stored in UniverseState.world_modifications[map_id] through MapStateStore.
